limits: Ordinary tests and stock are disjoint per OS. Targeted checkpoint/pipeline/first-use repetitions are not added to these totals.
Source-error and invalid-mode cases test explicitly distinct boundaries; they do not claim 40 Boolean parity successes.
One frozen source collection is reused across three OS, not three independent OS source oracles.
No full Unicode-string, complete-workflow, platform-wide or new numerical inference qualification. Existing numerical failures remain failures.
Build/step outcomes and marker evidence come from this exact CI head; no local .NET, native or source execution by this auditor.
Pinned committed files are not an attestation of every loaded binary. GitHub archive digest is retained separately from recomputed extracted TRX hashes.
